The apply_template returned '()' meaning no precursors? Possibly the template not applicable to given SMILES because the SMILES includes atom mapping numbers which may not be recognized. The initial molecule is given with atom mapping numbers. We may need to provide a standard SMILES without mapping. The initial molecule: [CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]

We need to strip mapping numbers. Let's convert to SMILES: CH2=C(c1ccccc1)C1CCC(C1)(O)C(F)(F)F? Wait there is chiral centers. The core: [CH2]=[C]([c]1ccccc1)C1CCC(C1)(O)C(F)(F)F. So SMILES: C= C(c1ccccc1)C1CCC(C1)(O)C(F)(F)F . But need to ensure correct double bond: CH2= C(...). So "C=C(c1ccccc1)C1CCC(C1)(O)C(F)(F)F". Let's try apply_template with that SMILES.
